en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4325 - Ishaq ibn Ammar asked Abu Ibrahim (Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as)) whether it is permissible to give expiation to someone who is weak but not from the people of wilayah (those who follow the Ahlulbayt).
Imam (as) said: "Yes, but the people of wilayah are more beloved to me."
